# Testing Standard

## Purpose

Define organization-wide testing expectations for quality and verification work.

## Scope

- Applies to implementation, review, and release confidence.
- Covers test strategy ownership and review boundaries.
- Avoids language-specific framework detail.

## Ownership

- Primary owner: quality engineering maintainers.
- Reviewers: capability owners and product engineering stakeholders.

## Review Process

- Keep the standard concise and easy to apply.
- Focus on organizational testing expectations rather than tool usage.
- Leave framework-specific practices to future modules or skills.

## Future Content

- Test strategy themes.
- Coverage and confidence expectations.
- Review and validation checkpoints.
- Quality gate expectations.
